messages:
aya: Pushed a docs PR that lays out the migration path for deprecated model variants and adds Ruby + Rust SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
frank: Nice. Can we include an explicit example showing aliasing behavior when a variant is removed? customers were confused when their model_alias started returning a different quantized variant.
aya: good call. added a short section: 'If you rely on model_alias, pin the model_version or provide an explicit model_variant in the request.' example included.
nina: For the Ruby snippet please show both sync and async clients. infra teams use both patterns.
aya: added Ruby sync and async. sample sync:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model: 'aurora-lite3b', input: 'hello')
puts resp.text
```
async example uses client.generate_async and a callback.
frank: Also include a small note about embedding dimension changes across variants. if a quantized variant drops some precision, downstream similarity pipelines should re-index. add a migration checklist item.
aya: added checklist: 1) verify embedding dims, 2) re-run similarity baselines, 3) bump shard_count if applicable.
nina: linter found a dead link to /docs/catalog#supported-models — looks like the anchor is now /docs/catalog#available-models. can you update cross-links?
build-bot: Link validation failed: /docs/catalog#supported-models -> 404.
aya: fixed anchors and searched for other broken catalog links. replaced runtime#fallback with runtime#fallback-policies where needed.
frank: bench numbers would be useful. do we have p50/p95 for aurora-lite3b on V100 vs A10?
nina: i pasted quick infra numbers in the PR: V100 p50=12 tok/s, p95=4 tok/s; A10 p50=20 tok/s, p95=8 tok/s. added a short table and a sentence saying numbers are indicative and will vary.
aya: added a note about Dedicated autoscale cold-start: heavy variants can take ~20-40s to spin up; recommend pre-warm for predictable latency.
frank: small wording nit in the deprecation timeline. please clarify calendar days vs business days in the notification language.
aya: updated wording to "30 calendar days" and added an example timeline.
build-bot: Preview build complete: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/523 (build 7621) :white_check_mark:
frank: i'll review and approve after a tiny edit. thanks for adding Ruby + Rust.
aya: thanks all — plan to merge after reviews and after CI green. ping me if you want the snippets converted to another language. :shipit:
